feeds.title: HealthToday
feeds.description: HealthToday is an award-winning magazine dedicated to the holistic aspects of healthy living. We work closely with local medical professionals and non-government organizations in Malaysia.

feeds.title: F1 Recreation Blog
feeds.description: Ever since F1 Recreation was born in 2006, we have worked hard to bring to life our vision of delivering exceptional value to inspire and empower quality living. We began by providing home gym equipment and commercial gym equipment to our clients and become the best fitness gym equipment provider in Malaysia. We expanded to include the management of gyms.

feeds.title: Desire Gym Blog
feeds.description: Since 2014, DESIRE LIFESTYLE SDN. BHD. (1184303M) has strived to provide premium home fitness equipment for all Malaysians at the most reasonable and affordable prices. Due to our expertise in setting up commercial fitness centers, you can trust that you'll get quality gym equipment you can use from the comfort of your home.

feeds.title: Pinnacle Fitness Blog
feeds.description: Our company was established in 2002 and for the past 20 years, we have been helping Malaysians get fitter, stronger, and better, by improving their health through fitness. Fitness centers come and go at an astonishing rate. Each riding is the new fitness craze of the day. Pinnacle Fitness has been in continuous operation for 20 years simply because we stick to the basics - our clients always come first.

feeds.title: Kevin Zahri Blog
feeds.description: Kevin Zahri is a multi-award-winning US-certified personal trainer and nutritionist who is renowned for his work in the field of weight loss. With over 18 years of experience, he's passionate about helping people to pursue their wellness goals. A social influencer and digital entrepreneur, Kevin has over 1 million followers on all of his social media combined. Affectionately known as Cikgu Fitness Malaysia, Kevin's mission is to empower people with knowledge and tools to achieve their fitness goals.

feeds.title: DailyVanity Malaysia » Fitness
feeds.description: Daily Vanity is a reliable media resource for beauty novices and beauty enthusiasts alike. We have content for everyone regardless of age and spending preference. read fitness, health, and wellness tips like how to lose weight and get healthy that are written by Asians for Asians.

feeds.title: Desire Gym Blog
feeds.description: Desire Gym Blog shares useful information and knowledge related to fitness and health, such as workout tips, reviews of fitness equipment, and information on nutrition. The website also appears to sell fitness equipment, supplements, and other health products.

feeds.title: Life n Fitness Blog
feeds.description: At Life n Fitness, we believe that exercise is not torture or something that makes you suffer. In addition to all the physical and mental health benefits, exercise can bring a lot of joy, laughter, and meaning to our lives. Check out our Blog for the latest tips and info regarding daily fitness routines, Exercises, and healthy food habits to bring out your true self.

feeds.title: NaturalHealth MY » Fitness
feeds.description: Natural Health is the first and only magazine dedicated to guiding women to take action toward a healthier and better life naturally. It offers readers fresh and informative content on a diverse range of natural health alternatives from traditional to complementary so that they can make educated decisions for themselves and their families. Read the latest fitness articles giving you tips and tricks to stay healthy and fit.

feeds.title: Move Private Fitness Blog
feeds.description: Move Private Fitness was founded in 2018 with a singular goal in mind: To support and transform lives using a systematic and personalized approach to fitness and wellbeing. Get 1-on-1 personal training for aesthetic, post-rehab, sports performance, and reverse aging in a private, exclusive, and appointment-based studio with your Certified Personal Trainer who brings passion into every single encounter with you.

feeds.title: Running-Malaysia
feeds.description: RUNNING MALAYSIA is the first running magazine in Malaysia that puts forward the best interests of all runners across the nation. Dedicated to delivering the latest running news, events, tips, gadget features, nutrition, and wellness advice, Running Malaysia is the one-stop source for information for running enthusiasts and athletes from amateur to experienced ones.
